title: Design System: Flight of the Goldfinch

shadows.name: painting-depth
shadows.purpose: Places the Fabritius panel inside the dark room.

shadows.name: bird-depth
shadows.purpose: Separates the moving bird from atmospheric scenes.

motion.name: confident-arrival
motion.purpose: Short opacity arrivals and canvas readiness.

components.name: Restart control
components.description: Returns the visitor to the beginning from the colophon.
components.css: .ds-restart { border: 0; background: transparent; color: #d8d0bf; font: 600 0.72rem/1.4 'Source Serif 4', Georgia, serif; letter-spacing: 0.13em; text-transform: uppercase; text-underline-offset: 0.3em; cursor: pointer; } .ds-restart:hover { color: #c9a24b; } .ds-restart:focus-visible { outline: 1px solid #c9a24b; outline-offset: 6px; }

narrative.northStar: The world inside the panel, filmed on old stock.
narrative.overview: A continuous portfolio artwork with photographic bones beneath a painted, filmic atmosphere. The interface recedes and the visitor controls time through scroll.

rules.name: The Scarcity Rule
rules.body: Gilt, red wax, and canal blue remain rare so they retain narrative force.

rules.name: The Two Voices Rule
rules.body: EB Garamond carries literature and Source Serif 4 carries apparatus; introduce no third typographic voice.

dos: Make every transition feel continuous and reversible.
Keep the bird motionless when the visitor is motionless.
Let the five real artworks remain clear and unobstructed.
donts: Do not add chapters, progress UI, sound, or a return-to-Hijinx link.
Do not perform snow or a whiteout in Amsterdam.
Do not bake quotations into imagery or repeat their attribution.
